title: Build TodoFooter component with count, filters, clear completed, and toggle all
active_form: Building TodoFooter component with count, filters, clear completed, and toggle all
description:
Create the TodoFooter component that provides status information and bulk actions. It displays the active (incomplete) todo count with correct pluralization ('{n} item left' / '{n} items left'). It renders three filter buttons (All, Active, Completed) with the active filter visually highlighted, calling onFilterChange when clicked. A 'Clear completed' button is visible only when at least one completed todo exists, calling onClearCompleted when clicked. A 'toggle all' control (chevron or checkbox) is visible when todos exist — clicking it calls onToggleAll. The footer should be hidden when no todos exist.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Sections 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, 5.8

functional: Active count displays with correct pluralization ('{n} item left' vs '{n} items left')
Count updates in real-time as todos are added, deleted, or toggled
Three filter buttons (All, Active, Completed) are visible
Active filter button is visually highlighted
Clicking a filter button calls onFilterChange with the filter value
'Clear completed' button visible only when completed todos exist
'Clear completed' button calls onClearCompleted when clicked
Toggle all control visible when todos exist
Toggle all calls onToggleAll when clicked
edge_cases: Footer hidden when no todos exist
'Clear completed' button hidden when no completed todos
Count shows 0 when all todos are completed

testing_requirements.target: Active count displays with correct pluralization
Filter buttons render and highlight active filter
Clear completed button visibility toggles based on completed todos
Footer hidden when no todos exist

metadata.feature_name: Todo Footer (Count, Filters, Clear Completed, Toggle All)
